protocol.scope: independent on-target training/search; total NAM gates then CX; no historical witness or model transfer
protocol.state: general ZX multigraph; raw state never overwritten by its scoring view; macro actions explicitly transition via that view
protocol.scoring: verified frozen fixed-wire completion/NAM cleanup; on failure/mismatch repair a separate copy with clifford_simp then full_reduce; first valid branch, exact view-key cache
protocol.unscored: verified legal child remains active and enters separate latent FIFO; actual cost=null; reward 0 until next success, then delta from last scored anchor
protocol.dedup: exact raw state archive/cost cache and within-proposal signatures; no permanent hard action suppression
protocol.proposals: 12 general-phase families; finite matching/candidates and per-template phase-operation budget 128
protocol.observation: raw colored multigraph + separate normalized graph, boundary correspondences, rule/direction/phase/shape, eight explicit context values
protocol.sampling: NumPy search/restart RNG separate from deterministic state/visit proposal RNG and torch PPO shuffle; frozen/online same init
protocol.reward: last successfully scored NAM delta / 10; no invented latent cost
protocol.verification: each unique raw/view state full fixed-wire operator; every unique QASM independent Qiskit operator; unit-modulus phase only
protocol.timing: setup/final model excluded; matching, state export/verification/extraction, graph objects, restart maintenance and PPO inside wall budget
protocol.limits: candidate/node/matching/horizon/latent-depth bounds; extraction failures are legal transitions, verification/resource failures rejected
protocol.hh: I_X backward / H forward / I_Z forward proof; every contextual cancellation has a replay receipt
protocol.invalid_extraction: quarantined and excluded from all gate costs/rewards; legal raw graph can continue. Raw/repair operator mismatches remain fatal. Repairs apply identically in every arm.
